import {
  defineApp,
  nav,
  Screen,
  Stack,
  Row,
  Card,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  NumberInput,
  Stepper,
  List,
  ListItem,
  EmptyState,
  Badge,
  Modal,
  Button,
  toast,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  storage,
  type SchemaArtifact,
} from 'vc-sdk';

// Recipes live in one kv value keyed by the literal string 'recipes'.
const SCHEMA: SchemaArtifact = {
  schemaVersion: 1,
  collections: {},
};

interface Recipe {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  ingredients: string;
  steps: string;
  prep: number;
  servings: number;
}

const DEFAULT_RECIPES: Recipe[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    name: 'Banana Oat Pancakes',
    ingredients: '2 ripe bananas, 2 eggs, 1 cup oats, 1 pinch cinnamon, 1 tsp oil',
    steps:
      'Mash the bananas in a bowl, Stir in the eggs and oats until smooth, Warm a little oil in a pan, Cook spoonfuls for 2 minutes a side',
    prep: 10,
    servings: 2,
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    name: 'Tomato Pasta',
    ingredients: '400 g pasta, 2 cups tomato sauce, 2 cloves garlic, 1 handful basil, 1 pinch salt',
    steps:
      'Boil the pasta in salted water, Warm the garlic in a wide pan, Add the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes, Toss with the pasta and tear in the basil',
    prep: 20,
    servings: 4,
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    name: 'Berry Yogurt Bowl',
    ingredients: '1 cup yogurt, 1 handful berries, 2 tbsp granola, 1 drizzle honey',
    steps: 'Spoon the yogurt into a bowl, Pile the berries on top, Sprinkle over the granola, Drizzle with honey',
    prep: 5,
    servings: 1,
  },
];

function toRecipe(raw: unknown): Recipe {
  const row = (raw ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    id: Number(row.id ?? 0),
    name: String(row.name ?? ''),
    ingredients: String(row.ingredients ?? ''),
    steps: String(row.steps ?? ''),
    prep: Number(row.prep ?? 0),
    servings: Number(row.servings ?? 1),
  };
}

/** One list split into parts: commas, or newlines if they ever arrive. */
function splitList(text: string): string[] {
  return text
    .split(/[,\n]/)
    .map((part) => part.trim())
    .filter((part) => part !== '');
}

// A tiny module-level store, so every mounted screen shows the same recipe box.
let CACHE: Recipe[] = [];
let selectedId = 0;
let editingId: number | null = null;
const listeners = new Set<(recipes: Recipe[]) => void>();

function publish(recipes: Recipe[]): void {
  CACHE = recipes;
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener(recipes));
}

function subscribe(listener: (recipes: Recipe[]) => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

async function loadRecipes(): Promise<Recipe[]> {
  const saved = await storage.kv.get('recipes');
  const list = Array.isArray(saved) ? (saved as unknown[]).map(toRecipe) : DEFAULT_RECIPES;
  if (!Array.isArray(saved)) await storage.kv.set('recipes', list);
  publish(list);
  return list;
}

async function saveRecipes(list: Recipe[]): Promise<void> {
  await storage.kv.set('recipes', list);
  publish(list);
}

function RecipeList() {
  const [recipes, setRecipes] = useState<Recipe[]>(CACHE);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    const unsubscribe = subscribe((list) => {
      if (live) setRecipes(list);
    });
    loadRecipes()
      .then((list) => {
        if (live) setRecipes(list);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (live) toast('Couldn’t load your recipes.');
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const shown = query === '' ? recipes : recipes.filter((recipe) => recipe.name.toLowerCase().includes(query));

  return (
    <Screen
      title="Recipe Box"
      action={{
        icon: 'plus',
        label: 'Add a recipe',
        onPress: () => {
          editingId = null;
          nav.navigate('RecipeForm');
        },
      }}
    >
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <TextInput value={search} placeholder="Search by recipe name" onChange={setSearch} />
        {recipes.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState icon="utensils" title="No recipes yet" hint="Tap + to add your first recipe." />
        ) : shown.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState icon="search" title="No recipes match" hint={`Nothing named “${search.trim()}” yet.`} />
        ) : (
          <Stack gap="lg">
            <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">
              {query === '' ? `${recipes.length} recipes` : `${shown.length} of ${recipes.length} recipes`}
            </Text>
            <List
              items={shown}
              keyBy="id"
              renderItem={(recipe) => (
                <ListItem
                  title={recipe.name}
                  subtitle={`${recipe.prep} min prep · ${recipe.servings} servings`}
                  icon="utensils"
                  onPress={() => {
                    selectedId = recipe.id;
                    nav.navigate('RecipeDetail');
                  }}
                />
              )}
            />
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

function RecipeDetail() {
  const [recipes, setRecipes] = useState<Recipe[]>(CACHE);
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    const unsubscribe = subscribe((list) => {
      if (live) setRecipes(list);
    });
    loadRecipes()
      .then((list) => {
        if (live) setRecipes(list);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (live) toast('Couldn’t load this recipe.');
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  const recipe = recipes.find((item) => item.id === selectedId);

  if (recipe === undefined) {
    return (
      <Screen title="Recipe">
        <EmptyState icon="utensils" title="Recipe not found" hint="It may have been deleted." />
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  const ingredients = splitList(recipe.ingredients);
  const steps = splitList(recipe.steps);

  const removeRecipe = () => {
    const name = recipe.name;
    saveRecipes(recipes.filter((item) => item.id !== recipe.id))
      .then(() => {
        setConfirming(false);
        toast(`${name} deleted`);
        nav.back();
      })
      .catch(() => toast('Couldn’t delete that recipe.'));
  };

  return (
    <Screen
      title={recipe.name}
      action={{
        icon: 'pencil',
        label: 'Edit recipe',
        onPress: () => {
          editingId = recipe.id;
          nav.navigate('RecipeForm');
        },
      }}
    >
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <Row gap="sm">
          <Badge label={`${recipe.prep} min prep`} tone="primary" />
          <Badge label={`${recipe.servings} servings`} />
        </Row>

        <Stack gap="sm">
          <Text size="subtitle">Ingredients</Text>
          {ingredients.length === 0 ? (
            <Text color="text-muted">No ingredients listed yet.</Text>
          ) : (
            <List>
              {ingredients.map((ingredient, index) => (
                <ListItem key={index} title={ingredient} />
              ))}
            </List>
          )}
        </Stack>

        <Stack gap="sm">
          <Text size="subtitle">Steps</Text>
          {steps.length === 0 ? (
            <Text color="text-muted">No steps listed yet.</Text>
          ) : (
            <List>
              {steps.map((step, index) => (
                <ListItem key={index} title={step} trailing={`Step ${index + 1}`} />
              ))}
            </List>
          )}
        </Stack>

        <Button label="Delete recipe" variant="danger" icon="trash-2" onPress={() => setConfirming(true)} />
      </Stack>

      <Modal visible={confirming} title="Delete this recipe?" onClose={() => setConfirming(false)}>
        <Text color="text-muted">{recipe.name} will be removed from your box.</Text>
        <Row>
          <Button label="Delete" variant="danger" icon="trash-2" onPress={removeRecipe} />
          <Button label="Keep it" variant="secondary" onPress={() => setConfirming(false)} />
        </Row>
      </Modal>
    </Screen>
  );
}

function RecipeForm() {
  const [editId] = useState<number | null>(editingId);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [ingredients, setIngredients] = useState('');
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState('');
  const [prep, setPrep] = useState(15);
  const [servings, setServings] = useState(4);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editId === null) return;
    let live = true;
    loadRecipes()
      .then((list) => {
        if (!live) return;
        const recipe = list.find((item) => item.id === editId);
        if (recipe === undefined) return;
        setName(recipe.name);
        setIngredients(recipe.ingredients);
        setSteps(recipe.steps);
        setPrep(recipe.prep);
        setServings(recipe.servings);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (live) toast('Couldn’t load that recipe.');
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [editId]);

  const save = () => {
    const trimmed = name.trim();
    if (trimmed === '') return;
    const fields = {
      name: trimmed,
      ingredients: ingredients.trim(),
      steps: steps.trim(),
      prep,
      servings,
    };
    loadRecipes()
      .then((list) => {
        let next: Recipe[];
        if (editId === null) {
          const id = list.reduce((max, item) => Math.max(max, item.id), 0) + 1;
          next = [...list, { id, ...fields }];
        } else {
          next = list.map((item) => (item.id === editId ? { ...item, ...fields } : item));
        }
        return saveRecipes(next).then(() => {
          toast(editId === null ? `${trimmed} saved` : `${trimmed} updated`);
          if (editId === null) {
            nav.back();
          } else {
            selectedId = editId;
            nav.back();
          }
        });
      })
      .catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save that recipe. Try again.'));
  };

  return (
    <Screen title={editId === null ? 'New recipe' : 'Edit recipe'}>
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <TextInput label="Recipe name" value={name} placeholder="Banana oat pancakes" onChange={setName} />

        <Stack gap="sm">
          <TextInput
            label="Ingredients"
            value={ingredients}
            placeholder="2 bananas, 2 eggs, 1 cup oats"
            onChange={setIngredients}
          />
          <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Separate ingredients with commas.</Text>
        </Stack>

        <Stack gap="sm">
          <TextInput
            label="Steps"
            value={steps}
            placeholder="Mash the bananas, Stir in the eggs and oats, Cook on a warm pan"
            onChange={setSteps}
          />
          <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Separate steps with commas — they are numbered for you.</Text>
        </Stack>

        <Card>
          <Stack>
            <NumberInput label="Prep time (minutes)" value={prep} min={0} step={5} onChange={setPrep} />
            <Stepper label="Servings" value={servings} min={1} max={12} onChange={setServings} />
          </Stack>
        </Card>

        <Button
          label={editId === null ? 'Save recipe' : 'Save changes'}
          icon="check"
          disabled={name.trim() === ''}
          onPress={save}
        />
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

export default defineApp({
  name: 'Recipe Box',
  initial: 'RecipeList',
  screens: { RecipeList, RecipeDetail, RecipeForm },
  capabilities: ['storage'],
  schema: SCHEMA,
  tint: ['berry', 'rose', 'stone'],
  icon: 'utensils',
});
